section: Chassis and System Alarms / VPN Monitoring
content:
# Chassis and System Alarms / VPN Monitoring

Useful commands may include:

show chassis alarms

show system alarms

Alarm monitoring can help identify:

- Hardware fault
- Environmental issue
- Configuration issue
- System condition requiring attention

---

If VPNs are deployed, monitor:

- IKE state
- IPsec state
- Tunnel interface
- Peer reachability
- Traffic
- Route availability
- Application reachability

Tunnel status alone does not prove service availability.

---
